semiconductor_relevance: High — SAS Technology provides specialized equipment and services for the semiconductor and related industries, focusing on wet processing and facility management.
summary: SAS Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd is a provider of turn-key custom solutions in the semiconductor sector, specializing in wet processing capital equipment installation, used equipment refurbishment, and project management. The company also offers facilities management services and has partnerships with key equipment manufacturers.
capabilities: Wet processing capital equipment installation and de-installation

regional_presence.China: SAS Technology is based in Shanghai and operates as an exclusive distributor in the semiconductor and related industries.
